profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Jeppesen ForeFlight
profile.summary: Highly skilled and versatile software engineer with a passion for developing high quality software and a proven track record of delivering robust solutions for complex software systems in a wide variety of technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed components of a new, microservice-oriented procurement platform utilizing the following technologies: Spring Boot, Spring Security, RESTful web services, WebSockets, Hibernate, postgres

Enhanced and fixed legacy, web-based procurement products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development lead for an electronic payment system project for the Department of Treasury. Responsible for providing technical direction to team members as well as designing and developing new features, enhancements, and defect fixes.

Previously worked on a project developing software tools and libraries for electronic payment applications.

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for enhancing, hardening, optimizing, and maintaining various tools used to build, munge, and package "Star Wars The Old Republic" game assets

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed back-end and middle-ware software for a product managing 1000+ traffic signal controllers
